packages.name: probe-cli
packages.summary: Command probe-cli is a command line application built with cobra and a hexagonal (ports & adapters) core.

packages.name: cli
packages.summary: Package cli is the driving adapter: it turns command line input into calls on the inbound port and hands the results to a reporter.

packages.name: fake
packages.summary: Package fake holds in-memory implementations of every outbound port.

packages.name: httpprobe
packages.summary: Package httpprobe is the driven adapter that talks to real external systems over HTTP.

packages.name: logging
packages.summary: Package logging adapts log/slog to the port.Logger outbound port.

packages.name: report
packages.summary: Package report contains the driven adapters that present results.

packages.name: bootstrap
packages.summary: Package bootstrap is the process-level entry point: it owns the signal handling, the lifetime of telemetry and the mapping from an error to an exit code.

packages.name: buildinfo
packages.summary: Package buildinfo carries the identity of the binary.

packages.name: domain
packages.summary: Package domain holds the entities, value objects and rules that make up the core of the hexagon.

packages.name: port
packages.summary: Package port declares the boundary of the hexagon.

packages.name: service
packages.summary: Package service implements the inbound ports.

packages.name: observability
packages.summary: Package observability boots the OpenTelemetry SDK — traces, metrics and logs — for a short-lived CLI process.
